name: gps-mock-website
description: Marketing site for the app. Name, domain and links live in site.config.json.

scripts.build: node scripts/sync-config.mjs && vite build && node scripts/check-name.mjs && node scripts/check-size.mjs
scripts.shots: npm run build && node scripts/shot.mjs --dist dist --out shots
scripts.check:name: node scripts/check-name.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4 deploy
scripts.deploy:check: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4 deploy --dry-run
